name: ReSplat Initialization
definition: A method to predict an initial set of 3D Gaussians from a sparse point cloud by aggregating local and global 3D context to compensate for the information loss from downsampling the point cloud by 16x.
summary: ReSplat Initialization predicts initial 3D Gaussians from sparse point clouds by using transformer-based context aggregation to compensate for downsampling information loss, unlike naive direct mapping methods.
